Long, wavy, deep magenta hair with a center parting and thick bangs. Almond-shaped, pale violet eyes with a playful, mischievous expression. Appears to be in early twenties with a mature, refined face. Slender, graceful build wearing a signature high-collared dress in a palette of deep purple, gold, and white. Wears a gold circlet on the forehead and a wide, ornate gold belt.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
